verdict.rationale: Zero's README states that it does not track, collect, or sell user data, and the product can be self-hosted, which keeps mailbox data under the user's control. Together these imply user data is not used for model training, but neither is an explicit training commitment. missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control, disclosure of how third-party AI providers (e.g. Perplexity, the drafting and summarization models) handle email content, and independent verification of the data-handling claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way.
gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
